name: zoxide
summary: Smarter cd: learns the directories you visit and jumps with `z <partial>`; `zi` opens an fzf picker.
configFormat: environment variables read at `zoxide init` time; database file
startupCostMs: Measured 2026-11-23, Windows 11, zoxide 0.10.0 via scoop shim, median of 10: `zoxide init bash` 32 ms and `zoxide init powershell` 32 ms (empty `cmd /c rem` is 23 ms), so about one process spawn per shell start. The generated script is then parsed by the shell. Cache the output to a file and source it to skip the spawn.

windows.notes: Works in PowerShell (verified in Windows PowerShell 5.1) and in Git Bash/MSYS2/Cygwin bash. Database dir is %LOCALAPPDATA%\zoxide.

install.notes: Debian/Ubuntu packages are old (Debian 13: 0.9.7, Ubuntu 24.04: 0.9.3); the README recommends the install script there.

integration.notes: cd replacement, fzf picker, yazi/other tools that read the database.

theme.notes: No theme of its own. The `zi` picker is fzf: color it through FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS or _ZO_FZF_OPTS (see the fzf theme recipe).
